purpose: Seed for EP02 SC02 after EP02 SC01 formal test-mode segment. Use this to plan the next 8-10 second short-drama shots through ComfyUI.

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC01 is approved only for pipeline validation. Dialogue/localization drifted English in generated tests; production prompts must enforce Chinese dialogue/subtitles.

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, relic bundle.
White dragon-deer must remain a friendly mythic mount: white deer body, pearl neck and shoulder scales, pale jade antlers, long white mane, calm intelligent eyes.
Wufeng must remain a plain dark blunt rectangular edgeless black iron object, not a sharp sword.
Yuping Mountain / Tianhu must remain a moonlit pine and bamboo sanctuary with clear heavenly lake, austere wooden and bamboo pavilions, jade-green mist, and forbidden quiet.
Continue from the empty Qingdi courtyard hook: unseen authority, restrained tension, no direct Qingdi reveal unless the SC02 beat explicitly calls for it.
Use the final frame/visual logic of EP02 SC01 as temporal continuity; do not reset costume, mount identity, lake geometry, or courtyard mood.
localization_rules: All story/dialogue planning must be in Chinese unless a technical field requires English.
Storyboard and video prompts must explicitly say: Chinese short-drama style, Chinese dialogue only, Chinese subtitles only, no English spoken dialogue, no English captions, no English UI text.
If the provider tends to output English, render scenes with no readable text and add Chinese dialogue/subtitles later in editing, rather than letting the video model invent English text.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: experimental_file_ids only while current local backend supports it; otherwise use official T2V smoke tests or switch provider for formal I2V
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
